facts.fact: Carta de Moçambique reports that Mozambique's Law 34/2014 on the Right to Information, passed by Parliament on 26 November 2014, is being implemented, per the Ombudsman's annual report to the Assembly.
facts.system: Lei do Direito à Informação (Lei nº 34/2014)

facts.fact: The Ombudsman's annual report says public bodies received 60,433 information requests in 2024, of which 57,998 were granted (95%), 1,589 denied and 846 pending.
facts.system: Lei do Direito à Informação (Lei nº 34/2014)
